title: Bread and Circuses
text: The lower town is restless, and the Gate has been loud. Men gather on corners and fall quiet when a House's colors pass. Old men say the last time the city went this hungry for distraction, it found one in a burning, and they still remember the smell.

options.label: Fund the games, before the city finds its own (30 Gold).

outcomes.text: Your House pays for masks, wine and a pageant of the Pact. Your name is cheered in the streets, and the masks are worn for weeks after.
You keep your purse closed, and watch who pays, and who does not.

together.text: No House pays. The festival never happens, and the people do not forget.
Every House pays, and the games are remembered for a generation.
